annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, Government of Mauritius
annotation.venue: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (Mauritius) website
annotation.summary_en: Government press release announcing the launch of Mauritius' National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines (Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness and Integrity, Responsibility), an AI Unit website and regional AI marketplace, plus public-service AI tools. It contains no robotics or embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines launched for ethical, transparent AI adoption
AI Unit website and Regional AI Marketplace unveiled
Provisions being made to facilitate registration of AI startups and protect the local AI industry
Emphasis on AI training and skills development
Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029 and DIVA government AI assistant highlighted
